basis: The October 30 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its condensed consolidated income statement reports net sales of $242,274,000 for Q2 FY2025, the three months ended September 30, 2024, versus $258,400,000 a year earlier. Actual sales were $3,206,000 below the $245,480,000 cutoff. Both quarters include montratec, acquired May 31, 2023. The July outlook allowed a decline smaller than 5%.

coverage.detail: May 29, preceding earnings cycle. The issuer guided to low-single-digit net sales growth for Q1 FY2025 and for the full fiscal year. Neither forecast set a sales bound for Q2.
The May 29 management call likewise provided no qualifying September-quarter consolidated sales forecast.

July 31, Q1 earnings release. For the quarter ending September 30, management forecast net sales “Down low to mid-single digits year-over-year.” The low-single-digit decline at the high end of revenue allowed sales above $245,480,000.
July 31 earnings presentation, slide 14. The Q2 net sales outlook repeated the low-to-mid-single-digit decline.

On the July 31 call, the CFO repeated the Q2 sales range and said it incorporated the Monterrey consolidation. In Q&A, the CEO agreed Q2 was expected to be the year's low point without narrowing that range.
The August 8 Form 8-K disclosed the planned retirement of the president of the Americas. It supplied no Q2 sales update.

The September 19 D.A. Davidson investor presentation showed historical quarterly financials through Q1 FY2025. It supplied no Q2 consolidated sales figure or range establishing a decline of at least 5%.
October 16. The issuer scheduled the Q2 results release for October 30 before market open. The notice gave no preliminary sales figure.
October 21. The issuer announced a $0.07 quarterly dividend and gave no Q2 sales update.
October 30. The consolidated income statement's three-month net sales row gives 242,274 and 258,400, in thousands of dollars, and a 6.2% year-over-year decline.
Item 2.02 independently confirms the issuer released the September-quarter results on October 30, 2024.

publication_date_evidence: The earnings release carries an October 30, 2024 dateline and announces Q2 FY2025 results that day. The issuer's October 30 Form 8-K explicitly confirms the press release was issued on that date.
